subject: R session aborted when used some functions

messages.author: 2cb1774ccc445120
messages.subject: R session aborted when used some functions
parts:
Dear developers,

I am trying to run Altuna's methylKit tutorial on RStudio  (R version 3.1.2 and methyl kit 0.9.4), I did it once on R 3.0.2 (methylKit version 0.9.2) and had no problems, but now every time that I try to use the following functions my R session is aborted with the message that says: "R encountered a fatal error. The session was terminated". I couldn't find anything online that referred to the problem.

The commands terminating R are:
PCASamples(meth) 
PCASamples(meth, screenplot = T)
calculateDiffMeth(meth) 

all the other commands not related to these two functions or the objects returned by them worked.

> sessionInfo()

Platform: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu (64-bit)

locale:
 [1] LC_CTYPE=en_US.UTF-8       LC_NUMERIC=C               LC_TIME=en_US.UTF-8        LC_COLLATE=en_US.UTF-8     LC_MONETARY=en_US.UTF-8

[11] LC_MEASUREMENT=en_US.UTF-8 LC_IDENTIFICATION=C       

attached base packages:
[1] stats4    parallel  stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     

other attached packages:
[1] methylKit_0.9.4      GenomicRanges_1.18.4 GenomeInfoDb_1.2.4   IRanges_2.0.1        S4Vectors_0.4.0      BiocGenerics_0.12.1 

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] chron_2.3-45     data.table_1.9.4 plyr_1.8.1       Rcpp_0.11.4      reshape2_1.4.1   stringr_0.6.2    tools_3.1.2      XVector_0.6.0

Thanks in advance,

Jessica Temporal
